name: Academic Bank of Credits (ABC)
description: National digital storehouse of academic credits earned from HEIs, enabling transfer and accumulation.
eligibility: Students of participating Higher Education Institutions.
benefits: Store credits, transfer across institutions, flexible degree pathways.
application_steps: Create ABC ID via abc.gov.in / institutional link.
validity: Credits valid per UGC framework duration.

faq.q: Who can open an ABC account?
faq.a: Students of ABC-participating higher education institutions.

ai_summary: ABC is a national digital credit bank letting HEI students store and transfer academic credits.
ai_explanation: The Academic Bank of Credits gives each student an ABC ID to accumulate credits earned from participating universities, which can later be transferred toward a degree under the National Credit Framework. It promotes flexible, multiple-entry learning.
common_questions: How do I create an Academic Bank of Credits account?
Can I transfer credits between universities?
suggested_followups: How do I link my ABC ID with my university?
What is the National Credit Framework?
